intro.fr: Hungry Pumkin se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Hungry Pumkin can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub NotFamilyJules/hungry_pumkin_ap, qui héberge l'APWorld de Hungry Pumkin.
text.en: The GitHub repository NotFamilyJules/hungry_pumkin_ap, home of the Hungry Pumkin APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.1, seule version parue au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version v0.1 is released, the only one as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: Hungry Pumkin figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Hungry Pumkin is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
